title: Sample groups OUT — consolidated per-sample group assignments
description: One row per sample in the cohort. Each per-inversion karyotype call goes in karyotypes (a sub-object), so the outer table stays rectangular. The fields here are the *per-sample* covariates KBC needs as group labels or model covariates.

cohort_tag.description: Must equal 'gariepinus_hatchery_226' for KBC inputs (three-cohort rule).

sex.description: Phenotypic or genetic sex from the sample manifest, when available.

family_hub_id.description: Family-hub assignment (HANDOFF.md rule 8). Used as a confound covariate, not a unit of analysis.

is_pruned_unrelated.description: True if the sample is in the NAToRA-pruned 81-unrelated subset. Headline KBC restricts to is_pruned_unrelated=true; secondary mixed-model mode uses the full cohort with kinship.

ancestry_group.description: Hard-call ancestry assignment = argmax of NGSadmix Q row. Null when NGSadmix output was not supplied.

ancestry_q.description: Full NGSadmix Q vector (one entry per ancestral component, summing to 1.0 ± 1e-6). Null when not supplied. Component labels live in the parent manifest, not per-sample.

f_roh.description: Per-sample F_ROH = (Σ ROH lengths) / genome_length_bp. Null when ROH BEDs were not supplied.

n_roh_segments.description: Number of ROH segments for this sample. Null when ROH BEDs were not supplied.

posterior.description: PCAngsd posterior for the assigned class. Null when not reported.

posterior_cutoff_applied.description: Echoed from sample_groups.in for provenance. Calls below this cutoff are returned as karyotype_class='NA'.

karyotypes.description: Map of inversion_id → karyotype call object. Inversions absent from the map are equivalent to karyotype_class='NA' for this sample.

qc_flags.description: Optional QC flags raised by upstream pipelines. KBC drops 'manifest_only_no_data' samples; the others propagate as covariates.
